title.zh: 将达沃市Toril区Binugao描笼涯的Toril国立中学附属校从Toril国立中学分离，改设为独立的Binugao国立中学，并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Separating the Toril National High School Annex in Barangay Binugao, Toril District From the Toril National High School in Toril, Both in Davao City, and Converting It Into a Separate and Independent National High School, to Be Known as the Binugao National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Toril National High School Annex in Barangay Binugao, Toril District From the Toril National High School in Toril, Both in Davao City, and Converting It Into a Separate and Independent National High School, to Be Known as the Binugao National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1996/ra_8228_1996.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Toril National High School Annex in Barangay Binugao, Toril District, Davao City, is hereby separated from the Toril National High School in Toril, also of the same city, and converted into a separate and independent national, high school, to be known as the Binugao National High School.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such and regulations as may be necessary carry out the provisions of this Act.
The amount necessary to can out the provisions of this Act shall be in eluded in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment in law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
